da-p.bio: Da-P is a Montreal producer and beatmaker associated with the ALAIZ collective and the wider Soulection orbit. His work bridges hip-hop, electronic production and R&B, with collaborations involving artists and producers from Montreal's internationally influential beat scene. Northern Dial carries Da-P as part of Quebec's modern production culture.

dj sanj.bio: DJ Sanj is a Canadian Punjabi and Bhangra producer whose career began in Toronto in the late 1990s before expanding internationally. Known for Desi mixtapes, Punjabi production and crossover work, he later became a prominent producer across the UK and South Asian music industries while maintaining strong Canadian ties. Northern Dial carries DJ Sanj as part of Canada's Punjabi music history.

aida.bio: Aïda is a Montreal-based Canadian singer-songwriter whose music blends pop, R&B and multicultural influences with a bilingual Frenglish identity. Rooted in Montreal's diverse music scene and African heritage, her work moves across languages and styles while centring a contemporary Quebec perspective. Northern Dial carries Aïda as part of Montreal's independent vocal scene.

latoya.bio: Latoya is a Canadian R&B vocalist associated with producer Dub J's Kitchener-Waterloo and Toronto-area hip-hop network. Dub J identifies Latoya among the Canadian talent he produced during the growth of his Q It Up Records catalogue. Northern Dial carries Latoya as part of the Canadian R&B and hip-hop ecosystem surrounding that era.

miranda.bio: Miranda is a Canadian R&B vocalist associated with producer Dub J's Q It Up Records network and frequently credited as part of Mystic & Miranda. Her work appears within a Canadian hip-hop and R&B catalogue that connected artists across Kitchener-Waterloo and Toronto. Northern Dial carries Miranda as part of that early-2000s Canadian scene.
